status: frozen 2026-10-08: sp_chicago_model_v1 with the U1 commerce land share added (user decision); any change is sp_chicago_model_v3
supersedes: sp_chicago_model_v1, kept unchanged with its results in analysis/results/SP_CHI/sp_chicago_model_v1_2026_10_06
decision: User, 8 October 2026: add the U1 commerce share although it failed the J-3 admission rule (|Spearman| 0.708 with U6 intensity in São Paulo, rule < 0.70), because commercial land is central to Brás's profile. The overlap with U6 is accepted and reported, not corrected.
families: the 12 families of analysis/config/chicago_model_v1.json (definitions, tables and SHA-256), São Paulo rows from the same tables; family_columns overrides a family's columns
u3_sao_paulo_definition: Census 2022 residents per km2 of land (S3-0 catch-up)
missing: U1 (all four shares) under 10% classified occupied land: Marsilac, Parelheiros, O'Hare; available-case distance (J-8)

c6_scaling.u6_composition: city-centred log-ratios (relative); all-absolute uses raw log-ratios

model.scaling: z-score, population SD, capped at +-3, over 173 units (absolute) or within each city (relative)
model.budgets: equal per family; U6 = 1/2 intensity + 1/2 Aitchison composition
model.calibration: median positive pairwise value over all 14,878 pairs

runs.R2: PCA of the R1 geometry, fewest components >= 90%
runs.R3: drop scalar columns while any pair |Spearman| >= 0.70 on the scaled 173 values

model.robustness: 500 weight draws (seed 20261006, x U(0.5,1.5), 80% stability), leave-one-family-out, J-9 alternatives
model.implementation: analysis/scripts/sp_chicago_model.py (SP_CHI_MODEL_VERSION=v2, the default; reuses chicago_model.py); notebook analysis/sp_chicago_model_analysis.ipynb; report docs/harmonization/MODEL_REPORT.md §11
model.within_family_weights: equal: a block averages its columns with weight 1 each (U1: four shares, 1/4 of the U1 budget each). Explorer and Curio lane H let a user set column weights; the block's calibration is then recomputed on the reweighted block, so the family budget and the mix inside the family stay independent
